newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a liquid private-sector market on Wednesday to 9-7/8 percent from Tuesday's range of between 10 and 10-1/8 percent, bankers said.
One-week rates fell to 9-7/8 percent, against a range of between 10 and 10-3/16 percent on Tuesday, they added.
Most bankers said they did not do any overnight or one-week deals because they were long.
The validity of two repo offers of 500 million pounds ($147 million) each will end on Thursday and this will alleviate the current liquidity, the bankers said.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
